Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput numbers you showed are encouraging. Curie Health would like to formalize a short mutual action plan so we can validate performance with a week-long trial and align procurement timelines. High level asks from our side:

- Confirm GPU pool sizing guidance for our expected 1.5M tokens/day baseline (burst to 3M).
- Agree on a 7-day evaluation plan, target latency SLOs (p50/p95), and test datasets (PHI-masked examples).
- Outline contract and procurement steps so we can hit a May 1 start date if the eval looks good.

Can we schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff tomorrow to introduce stakeholders and agree roles? I’ve included Priya (CTO) on this thread.

Thanks — Sam

> Hi Sam — great to connect. Quick response to get the kickoff scheduled and next steps in motion. ...

Thanks — adding a few technical starter notes so the MAP has concrete testable targets.

- For 1.5M tokens/day baseline with 2k avg request window we recommend an initial pool of 8 A100-80GB equiv GPUs (dedicated) with a configured burst policy to 12 GPUs for peak hours. That maps to our runtime observability and KV cache assumptions.
- Preliminary latency targets: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 420ms for 2k token completion on the curated test set (PHI-masked). We’ll instrument with token-level tracing and share a small eval harness.
- Suggested evaluation steps (we can put these into the MAP doc):
  * Day 0: Environment & data checklist, access tokens, sample scripts
  * Day 1–2: Baseline run (no cache warmup)
  * Day 3–5: Cache/steady-state runs + latency analysis
  * Day 6–7: Edge-case stress (burst) and final report

I’ll populate the throughput spreadsheet with these knobs and add notes on acceptable variances. Rishi — can you confirm whether Curie’s planned doc-retention and token masking needs any infra-side prep?

— Vivek
